title: YURI Cross-Reference Hit v0
description: Canonical shape for a single cross-reference hit surfaced by the XREF engine. Closed (additionalProperties:false) at every object level: fail-closed on unknown fields, consistent with the privacy-gate ALLOWED_STRING_PATHS discipline (yuri-energy-trace.mjs). A hit's provenance.evidenceKind + numeric confidence determine whether it is surfaced or routed to the low-confidence sub-log. A sub-0.55 hit MUST carry a named provenance.mismatch or it is suppressed (mechanism-fit-theater gate). A writes-edge neighbor is never a sibling and never reaches this schema as a surfaced hit.
